title: Adversarial player input handling: out-of-turn, impossible actions, replay attacks
description: Systematically test and harden against adversarial players. Out-of-turn action submission must be rejected. Actions referencing non-existent components, wrong zones, other players' pieces must fail cleanly. Duplicate/replayed action sequences must be idempotent or rejected. Ensure error messages never leak hidden state (opponent's hand, deck order, fog-of-war zones).
